overview.about: The Truist Championship is a PGA Tour signature event, long associated with Quail Hollow Club in Charlotte - a demanding, tree-lined course whose brutal closing three holes are known as 'the Green Mile'. Formerly the Wells Fargo Championship, it draws one of the strongest fields outside the majors.
overview.nextEvent: The next Truist Championship is played at Quail Hollow Club in Charlotte, North Carolina. As a limited-field signature event it carries a large purse, and the closing Green Mile regularly decides it.
